title_en: New Fallout Funko Pop Figures Are Now Available To Preorder Ahead of Their November Release, Including Vault Boy, Nuka-Girl, and More
summary_en: Preorders have dropped for new Fallout Funko Pop figures, which are set to be released this November. Priced at $14.99 a piece, here's where you can secure each figure.
body_en:
Funko Pop is unleashing some new Fallout figures into the wild this year: Vault Boy , Nuka-Girl , Cappy , and Bottle . Priced at $14.99 a piece, each of these is set to be released in just a few months on November 22, just in time for the holiday season. If you're a big fan of the games (or maybe fell in love with them while watching the TV show ), these look well worth picking up to add to your collectibles.
As is the case with most Funko Pop figures, these are all fairly small (around 3.75 inches tall), so will slot nicely into an existing collection of Fallout-themed goodies. They each have quite fun designs as well.
While Cappy and Bottle are just happily posed with waving hands and big smiles, Nuka-Girl is pictured blasting off in a spacesuit with a ray gun, and Vault Boy is modeled with a classic thumbs up pose and a wink. The latter is a slightly different pose to the Vault Boy Funko Pop that released last year for the TV show , as that one was all wide-eyed smiles while posing instead of the wink.
While their release date isn't until late in November, it's worth preordering these now if one or more of them have caught your eye, rather than waiting. These kinds of figures can sell out faster than you'd think, so it's always a good idea to secure your favorites now before stock is all sold out.
If you're looking for even more Fallout items to buy for your shelves, we've got your covered. Our rundown of the best Fallout gear and collectibles highlights some of our favorite finds we think are worth your time, but the IGN Store is also chock-full of Fallout collectibles to look through. No matter if you've been a longtime fan of the games or just really love the show, there's a little something for everyone.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the guides and commerce teams here at IGN.
